summary: Paraglider crashed into the Eagle River near the Eagle County Fairgrounds about 9 a.m.; nearby rafters pulled the victim from the water onto their raft; first responders met the raft near Draggin A Ranch a couple of miles downriver; victim transported to a nearby hospital, condition unknown at publication; FAA/NTSB notified.
location: Eagle River near Eagle County Fairgrounds, Eagle
notes: Agencies per ECSO release: Eagle County Sheriff's Office, Vail Mountain Rescue Group, Greater Eagle Fire Protection District, Gypsum Fire Protection District, Eagle County Paramedic Services.
